scenario: A 500-person software company has functional silos (dev, test, product, ops). Projects constantly miss deadlines because handoffs between departments take weeks. The CEO wants to move to a matrix but fears chaos.
Our company tried matrix before but project managers were just coordinators with no real authority. Teams still reported to functional bosses. How do we do it right this time?
We are setting up a product committee and cross-functional product teams. Should the product manager or the R&D director have final say on staffing?
How do we prevent employees from feeling they have two bosses and conflicting priorities in a matrix setup?
Design a matrix organization for our consulting firm where consultants belong to practice areas but are deployed to client projects.
